releases.description:
## Initial release

- Adds a small folder button before each folder name in Obsidian's File Explorer
- Opens the selected local Vault folder in Windows Explorer
- Supports Japanese names and paths containing spaces
- Windows 11 / Obsidian Desktop / local Vaults only
- No telemetry, ads, or external communication
